title: SDLC Step ID v1
description: A numeric step identifier within a work item. It contains two through eight digits, and leading zeroes are significant so legacy two-digit steps and eight-digit task-tree positions can share one value type.
$comment: StepId has the form [0-9]{2,8}. Examples include 05 for a legacy ordered step and 50000000 for an eight-digit task-tree position. StepId is the local portion of TaskIdentifier and is not a complete task identity by itself.
